transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this pre-show huddle started. We've got the one-night orchestral film-score performance tonight at 7:30 PM in the Grand Hall, and I need to hear from each of you — music, rigging, and artist leads — on any changes before I finalize the production sheet. Currently we're listing 18 musicians, two suspended scenic frames, and a rehearsal from 4:00 to 5:00 PM. Who wants to go first?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a change on the music side. This morning I confirmed that the signed musicians agreement for this repertoire actually requires exactly 24 players, not 18. It also requires a 20-minute break from 8:15 PM to 8:35 PM. I haven't entered this amendment in the production sheet yet, but it needs to be reflected before we finalize.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical rigging issue. My certified rigging inspection found that the overhead points may carry no more than 450 kg in total, but the two planned scenic frames and their rigging hardware would weigh 510 kg — that's 60 kg over the certified limit. One frame weighing 240 kg is within the certified limit, so we can safely suspend one frame but not both. I have not yet filed the revised load plan, so this needs to be addressed before we finalize the production sheet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a scheduling conflict on the artist side. I confirmed with the conductor's agent that the conductor and soloist are only available for a 90-minute rehearsal from 3:00 PM to 4:30 PM on performance day. This has not yet been added to the call sheet, and it directly conflicts with the current 4:00 PM to 5:00 PM rehearsal listed on the production sheet.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Update musician count from 18 to 24 and add the 20-minute break from 8:15 PM to 8:35 PM to the production sheet.
Reduce suspended scenic frames from two to one and have Sofia file the revised load plan reflecting the single 240 kg frame within the 450 kg certified limit.
Update rehearsal time from 4:00 PM–5:00 PM to 3:00 PM–4:30 PM on the production sheet and call sheet to match conductor and soloist availability.
